nodes.name: Chart.template.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm chart metadata template for the cert-manager chart, defining the chart name, description, keywords, maintainers, Artifact Hub annotations, and minimum Kubernetes version.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains {{IS_PRERELEASE}} placeholders and placeholder version/appVersion fields that the release tooling substitutes when generating the final Chart.yaml.

nodes.name: README.template.md
nodes.summary: Helm chart README combining installation, upgrade, and uninstall instructions with a complete auto-generated reference for every chart value (236 headings across global, controller, webhook, cainjector, and ACME solver settings).
nodes.languageNotes: The Configuration section is marked AUTO-GENERATED and is produced by helm-tool from the +docs annotations embedded in values.yaml; {{RELEASE_VERSION}} is substituted at release time.

nodes.name: signkey_annotation.txt
nodes.summary: Two-line metadata file holding the fingerprint and download URL of the GPG key used to sign cert-manager Helm chart releases, read by the build to annotate the generated Chart.yaml.
nodes.languageNotes: Consumed verbatim by make/manifests.mk via a read loop and written as an Artifact Hub signature-key annotation on the generated chart.

nodes.name: values.schema.json
nodes.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) validating the cert-manager Helm chart values, using 252 nested $defs entries to constrain every top-level value and each component's image, resource, scheduling, and security settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Built around a single helm-values root definition with additionalProperties: false and per-component $ref chains such as #/$defs/helm-values.cainjector.

nodes.name: values.yaml
nodes.summary: Default values for the cert-manager Helm chart, configuring the controller, webhook, cainjector, ACME solver, startup API check, CRDs, RBAC, monitoring, and shared global scheduling and image-pull settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavily documented with +docs:section and +docs:property comment annotations that drive README generation and the values schema.
